key_impacts: Harbor break walls overtopped; flooding of shoreline and city streets.
Damage to shoreline homes and boat docks.
Shoreline damage to public docks and cottages reported.
Water intake pumps impacted by large water level changes.

evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m at the harbor and 2 m along the nearby coastline.
